subject: Premium onramp & exception approval — uptime variance and renewal route
messages:
From: Maya Kapoor <maya.kapoor@finrelay.com>

Cc: ops@finrelay.com
Date: 2026-10-28T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recurring tail-latency spikes — renewal conversation and request for premium path

Irene —

Thanks for taking this. Over the last 6 business days we've seen intermittent tail-latency spikes that have impacted our feature flag rollout (attachments: uptime_summary_oct2026.pdf). P95 is within expectations, but the P99+ tail has caused visible customer errors on our production org.

We're approaching renewal next quarter and want to discuss two things: 1) what immediate mitigations Redwood can enable to reduce tail risk, and 2) whether we can qualify for a premium SLA on renewal (we're willing to commit longer term if we get stronger guarantees + a path for credits for the recent incidents).

Can we schedule a 30-min working session this week? If you need logs or additional telemetry, let me know — ops@finrelay.com can push anything required.

-Maya
Maya Kapoor
Head of Production Ops | FinRelay
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Maya Kapoor <maya.kapoor@finrelay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-29T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recurring tail-latency spikes — renewal conversation and request for premium path

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up and the attached summary. I reviewed the PDF and saw the same P99 spikes tied to bursty inference patterns across a small set of routes.

Quick plan:
- Immediate: enable prefix KV caching on the affected model routes and increase soft-concurrency limits for a 48-hour trial (we can flip this on today).
- Near-term: propose a dedicated pilot (reserved workers) for the busiest routes to reduce noisy neighbors; this is the clearest technical lever to reduce tail events.
- Commercial path: Marissa (cc'd) will draft an addendum that maps a premium SLA (99.95% uptime, defined maintenance windows), and we can include a one-time credit for the recent variance as part of renewal negotiations.

Ben — can you confirm the deployment steps and estimated time to enable the caching + soft-concurrency change? Grace — can you prepare a short runbook we can send to FinRelay for incident handling while we run the pilot?

I'll tee up a 30-min slot tomorrow.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Maya Kapoor <maya.kapoor@finrelay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-30T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recurring tail-latency spikes — deployment options and timeline

Maya / team —

Confirmed: we can enable prefix KV caching and bump soft-concurrency for the affected routes today with zero code changes. Estimated impact: should reduce median token gen times for repeat prefixes and cut down a chunk of tail cases where requests share context.

Dedicated pilot: provisioning a reserved worker pool (2 GPUs) and pinning the model variant typically takes 3 business days (testing included). During the pilot we can also enable continuous batching and a conservative token cap to avoid runaway latencies.

Work items:
- Today: toggle caching + soft-concurrency (1 hour maintenance window) — I'll schedule at 02:00 UTC to minimize impact.
- Pilot provisioning: start Nov 2, ready Nov 5.

I'll attach a short SLO snapshot after today’s change and share a brief ops checklist (slo_snapshot_oct29.png).

-ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Maya Kapoor <maya.kapoor@finrelay.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal / premium SLA path — proposed commercial terms

Maya —

Appreciate the quick collaboration on the technical side. Based on the mitigation + pilot plan, here's a commercial starter:

- Premium SLA: 99.95% uptime for supported routes, defined measurement windows and maintenance exclusions.
- Pricing: 12-month committed spend with a 20% premium over current committed unit price (we can discuss structure: flat uplift vs tiered seat).
- Goodwill: a one-time service credit equal to 5% of last invoice for October as recognition of the disruption; additional credits available if we miss the new SLA in the first 90 days.
- Kickoff: dedicated pilot included for first 30 days at no additional charge; after pilot you'll transition to reserved capacity billed under the premium tier.

I've uploaded a draft addendum and redlines: proposed_premium_addendum_v1.docx and started a DocuSign envelope (link below). If these terms look reasonable, sign the DocuSign and we'll queue legal for the final review.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-premium-addendum
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/FinRelay (for deal tracking)

Thanks — happy to adjust structure (commit term, credit amount) if you have constraints.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

1) Can the one-time goodwill credit be 10% of October invoice instead of 5%? That helps offset customer outreach costs.
2) We need an operational escalation SLA: guaranteed Red Team response within 30 minutes for production-impacting incidents during business hours for the first 90 days.

If you can confirm those two items are acceptable we'll sign the DocuSign this week. HubSpot deal ID is FINR-2026-87 for your records.
